tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in a text file: old_text must occur exactly once (copy it from read, whitespace included) unless replace_all is true.

new_text.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete old_text).

old_text.description: Exact text to replace, whitespace included; must occur exactly once unless replace_all.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List files and directories in a folder. Skips hidden and .gitignored entries. Optional glob filter; recursive for subfolders.

glob.description: Glob on paths as shown, e.g. "*.md" or "src/**/*.rs".

max_entries.description: Most entries to return; capped by the server limit.

path.description: Directory to list; omit or "." for the top.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Refuses to replace an existing target unless overwrite is true.

to.description: New path; parent directories are created.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a text file, optionally only lines start_line..end_line (1-based, inclusive). Small PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images come back as images; other binary files are reported, not returned.

end_line.description: Last line to return, inclusive (default: end of file).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search text files for a regular expression; returns path, line number and line for each match. Optional start path, glob filter, ignore_case.

glob.description: Glob on paths as shown, e.g. "*.rs".

path.description: Directory or file to search; omit for everything.

pattern.description: Regular expression (Rust regex syntax) matched against each line.

tools.name: stat
tools.description: Describe a path: kind (file, dir, symlink), size, modified time, line count for text files, image type for images.

path.description: Path to describe; "." for the top.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write text to a file. mode: create (default, fails if it exists), overwrite, or append. Creates parent directories.

oneOf.description: Create a new file; refuse if it exists.
Replace the file's content, creating it if missing.
Add to the end of the file, creating it if missing.

path.description: File to write; parent directories are created.
